subject: Kickoff: MedVantage marketplace MAP & evaluation plan
messages:
From: Jamie Ross <jamie.ross@nimbuscloud.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@medvantage.com>, AWS Marketplace - Listing Team <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff: MedVantage marketplace MAP & evaluation plan

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks for agreeing to run the marketplace listing with us. MedVantage (their product: CareSight) is ready to start a mutual action plan so we can align evaluation milestones, listing requirements, and a tentative close timeline. High-level asks from our side:

- Confirm internal owners on Redwood for commercial, partner ops, technical integration, and listing support.
- Agree an evaluation window (we're aiming for a 3-week technical eval starting mid-Jan).
- Share the AWS listing checklist and any preferred asset formats (we copied the AWS listing address above).

Proposed timeline:
- 2027-01-10 to 2027-01-31: Technical evaluation + integration tests
- 2027-02-01 to 2027-02-14: Marketplace intake + listing packaging
- 2027-02-25: Target live listing date (soft target)

Can we do a 30-minute sync this week to lock roles and the MAP owner? If you prefer, I can share a draft MAP (we have a template) ahead of the call.

Attaching a short intake note from MedVantage about compliance questions — they mentioned SOC2 scope and log retention.

Thanks,
Jamie Ross
Partnerships, NimbusCloud Partners
jamie.ross@nimbuscloud.com
+1 415-555-0192

Attachments: medvantage-intake-brief.pdf
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MedVantage marketplace MAP & evaluation plan

Jamie — thanks for the concise summary and the intake brief. Welcome Priya and team.

Quick intro and owners from Redwood:
- Commercial / MAP owner: Marissa Cole — will own pricing, deal milestones, HubSpot MAP record.
- Partner / Listing ops: Sergio Alvarez — primary for marketplace intake and AWS coordination.
- Technical integration lead: Karthik Iyer — will validate the integration and run the evaluation plan.
- Compliance / listing assets: Hannah Schmitt — asset checklist and SOC2 evidence point.

I attached our MAP template and the current AWS listing requirements we use for reference. Please review and flag any missing items.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Jamie/Priya — confirm MedVantage's preferred evaluation start date (you suggested mid-Jan).
2) Marissa to create a HubSpot MAP record and capture target close date (I set tentative to 2027-02-25).
3) Karthik to request a test account and technical contact at MedVantage for API keys / test traffic.
4) Sergio to open the AWS intake and share the listing intake link; Hannah to collate SOC2 evidence list.

Available for a 30-min slot: Wed 12/22 10:00-11:00 PT or Thu 12/23 14:00-15:00 PT. Which works for you?

V.

--
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Kickoff: MedVantage marketplace MAP & evaluation plan

On Mon, Dec 20, 2026 at 11:02 AM Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai> wrote:
> I attached our MAP template and the current AWS listing requirements we use for reference. Please review and flag any missing items.

Thanks Vanessa. A couple of technical asks to make the Jan eval productive:
- Please provide a sandbox/test tenant and API key (read/write) for CareSight test data.
- Share the expected sequence length & typical request concurrency for the pilot (batch sizes, average prompt lengths).
- We will run a compatibility check against our quantized runtime and a latency sweep; if you have any performance SLAs they should be noted in the MAP.

Evaluation acceptance criteria (proposed):
1) Integration succeeds with no functional regressions for core flows (patient anonymization, chart ingestion).
2) End-to-end 95th percentile token latency < 350ms under the pilot concurrency profile.
3) No PII leakage detected in 2 sample prompt suites.

Jamie / Priya — who will be our technical contact at MedVantage? If you share an account and a small test payload, we can draft the test plan this week.

Karthik
Principal Engineer, Platform Integrations
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
From: Jamie Ross <jamie.ross@nimbuscloud.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 22 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MedVantage marketplace MAP & evaluation plan

Great — thanks everyone for the quick alignment.

Updates from MedVantage: Priya (cc'd) will be the technical lead. She can create a sandbox tenant and provide API creds by 2027-01-06. Pilot usage estimate: ~12k tokens/day initially, ramp to 40k tokens/day during the evaluation window.

AWS listing team (cc) — Per our intake conversation, you'll need the finalized asset pack (one-pager, logo, SOC2 statement) and a signed intake form. Sergio / Hannah — can your team coordinate with aws-marketplace@amazon.com on asset formats and required metadata?

Proposed meeting: Wed 12/22 10:00 PT worked for a subset earlier — let's take the Thu 12/23 14:00 PT slot Vanessa suggested. I'll send a calendar invite with a short agenda: MAP owners, evaluation acceptance criteria, and AWS intake next steps.

Action items summary:
- Priya: sandbox + API creds by 2027-01-06.
- Karthik: draft evaluation test plan by 2027-01-04.
- Marissa: HubSpot MAP + pricing iteration by 2027-01-05.
- Sergio & Hannah: open AWS intake and confirm asset list by 2026-12-30.

Thanks — see you on Thu.

Jamie Ross
Partnerships, NimbusCloud Partners
jamie.ross@nimbuscloud.com
